questions.a1: Image input supports JPG/JPEG, PNG, and WebP.
questions.q2: What quality can I expect from PDF conversion?
questions.a2: PDF pages are rendered at a 2× scale; output quality and dimensions depend on the source page and selected format.
questions.q3: Is there a file size limit?
questions.a3: Images are limited to 10MB each and PDFs to 50MB.
questions.a4: File contents are processed in your browser and are not uploaded to a BravoConvert processing server.
questions.q5: Can I use this on mobile devices?
questions.a5: It works in compatible current browsers; support and performance vary by browser and device.
